strategy.offer: Sustainable industrial technologies and products turning biomass and waste into nutrients, fertilizers, fuels, energy, plus engineering, automation and prototyping services.
strategy.customers: Food, agriculture, chemicals, cosmetics and waste-management users, plus organizations needing decentralized energy, custom equipment, or environmentally oriented consumer and reseller products.
strategy.why_we_win: By combining disruptive thinking with viable business models, making previously uneconomic technologies practical, sustainable and cost-competitive.
strategy.resources: An interdisciplinary research and engineering team spanning science, automation, business development, marketing and distribution, supported by in-house prototyping and reinvested revenues.
strategy.direction: To launch many more technology ventures and broaden deployment of existing and new sustainable solutions over coming decades.
